description: This file defines an Orleans grain class 'AccountGrain' that models a bank account with event sourcing capabilities, including deposit and withdrawal operations, and a variant 'AccountGrain_PersistStateOnly' that only persists the latest state without full event sourcing.

classes.name: AccountGrain
classes.description: A journaled grain implementing a bank account with event sourcing, supporting deposit, withdrawal, and transaction log retrieval.

classes.name: AccountGrain_PersistStateOnly
classes.description: A variant of AccountGrain that only persists the latest state without full event sourcing.

classes.name: AccountGrain.GrainState
classes.description: Represents the current state of the account, primarily the balance, with methods to apply deposit and withdrawal transactions.

methods.name: Balance
methods.description: Returns the current balance of the account.

methods.name: Deposit
methods.description: Deposits a specified amount into the account, raising a deposit event.

methods.name: Withdraw
methods.description: Attempts to withdraw a specified amount, raising a conditional withdrawal event if sufficient funds exist.

methods.name: GetTransactionLog
methods.description: Retrieves the list of confirmed transactions.
